item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find credible 2024 evidence of Tshisekedi personally urging hatred, revenge, dehumanization, or violence against ethnic/religious groups, migrants, journalists, or civil society in the direct sense this lens asks about. What I did find is narrower: external scapegoating of Rwanda/M23, war-threat rhetoric, and an environment where repression of opponents was justified through enemy-framing.","evidence":[{"title":"DRC: President Tshisekedi must use second term to tackle human rights crisis","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-06-24","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/06/drc-president-tshisekedi-must-use-second-term-to-tackle-human-rights-crisis/","summary":"Amnesty says Tshisekedi’s administration had made little progress on human rights and that conflict and civic-space restrictions persisted. This is background only, but it supports the broader environment in which hostile political framing mattered.","question_ids":["3B.3","3B.2"]},{"title":"Crackdown framed as defense against enemies","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-09-30","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/09/drc-president-felix-tshisekedi-must-be-held-accountable-for-human-rights-violations/","summary":"Amnesty says journalists, civil society activists, and political opponents faced threats, arbitrary detention, and judicial harassment under a crackdown justified as defending the country against enemies. This is indirect evidence of scapegoating opponents and enabling hostility, though not a direct quote of personal hate speech.","question_ids":["3B.3","3B.1","3B.2"]},{"title":"Le Président Felix Tshisekedi réclame des sanctions ciblées contre le Rwanda pour mettre fin à la crise sécuritaire à l’Est de la Rdc","publisher":"Présidence RDC","date":"2024-09-25","url":"https://www.presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/le_president_felix_tshisekedi_reclame_des_sanctions_ciblees_contre_le_rwanda_pour_mettre_fin_a_la_crise_securitaire_a_lest_de_la_rdc","summary":"Tshisekedi publicly labeled Rwanda an aggressor and M23 a terrorist group and called for targeted sanctions. This is strong external scapegoating and conflict-hardening rhetoric, but the remedy sought was lawful international pressure rather than violence against a domestic group.","question_ids":["3B.3","2B.6","2B.10"]},{"title":"Les Présidents Félix Tshisekedi et Emmanuel Macron ensemble pour le développement et la paix en Rdc","publisher":"Présidence RDC","date":"2024-04-30","url":"https://www.presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/les_presidents_felix_tshisekedi_et_emmanuel_macron_ensemble_pour_le_developpement_et_la_paix_en_rdc","summary":"Tshisekedi framed the eastern crisis around peace, de-escalation, and international support, saying there was “a glimmer of hope” after discussions with Macron. This is counterevidence to a claim that he was personally pushing hatred or revenge.","question_ids":["3B.3","2B.7","2B.10"]},{"title":"UN Secretary-General readout: Tshisekedi discussed eastern DRC and ongoing regional peace efforts","publisher":"United Nations","date":"2024-09-24","url":"https://www.un.org/sg/en/content/sg/readouts/2024-09-24/readout-of-the-secretary-generals-meeting-he-mr-felix-antoine-tshisekedi-tshilombo-president-of-the-democratic-republic-of-the-congo-scroll-down-for-french","summary":"The UN readout shows Tshisekedi kept the issue in a diplomatic, peace-process frame rather than an ethnic or sectarian hate frame. This is the clearest positive evidence I found.","question_ids":["3B.3","2B.7","2B.10"]},{"title":"Tshisekedi calls for urgent relaunch of the Nairobi and Luanda peace processes","publisher":"Présidence RDC","date":"2024-03-25","url":"https://presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/crise_securitaire_dans_lest_de_la_rdc_les_presidents_felix_tshisekedi_et_salva_kiir_appellent_au_respect_des_accords_de_paix","summary":"Tshisekedi publicly called for peace-process renewal and said he would spare no effort to restore peace, security, and stability. This cuts against a finding of personal incitement.","question_ids":["3B.3","2B.7","2B.10"]},{"title":"Threat rhetoric toward Rwanda","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-07-04","url":"https://d2233.cms.socastsrm.com/2024/07/04/army-disarray-hobbles-congos-fight-with-rwanda-backed-rebels-officers-say/","summary":"Reuters reported that Tshisekedi threatened to declare war against Rwanda while also relying on proxy forces. This is the strongest direct negative evidence I found for escalation rhetoric, but it is state-directed conflict rhetoric rather than personal incitement against an internal ethnic, religious, or social group.","question_ids":["3B.3","2B.6","2B.8"]}]}
